reviews.text:
Jason, would you please explain why this extension requires the following permissions?
 "Read and change all your data on all websites"

Updated review: bumped this from 1 to 5 stars as Jason got back to me, same day via email, with the following answer.

" If you use the default usage #1 method than you will only need the "Read your browsing history" permission.
         Usage #1: Ideal for developers (recommended)

If you use "Usage #2: For basic users" it will require all the permissions to "Read and Change ALL you data on ALL websites"

Go with Usage #1 if you'd like to limit the permissions for this extension. 
Thanks Jason!
Works great, however some issues while using with few websites like google sheets.
